votes.motion: Adjourn as the City Council and meet as the Community Reinvestment Board (CRA) for the CRA meeting.
votes.description: The Council voted to adjourn from their City Council session and convene as the Community Reinvestment Agency Board to conduct the scheduled CRA meeting.

votes.motion: Reconvene as the CRA Board to approve the Consent Agenda.
votes.description: The Council voted to reconvene as the CRA Board in order to approve the Consent Agenda item that had been inadvertently omitted during the earlier CRA meeting.
